faqs.question: Do I need a doctor's consultation for regenerative medicine?
faqs.answer: Yes. All PRP, exosome, and intimacy treatments require a medical consultation. You will talk with our licensed medical doctor who evaluates your joint, hair, or intimacy health before creating your custom plan.

faqs.question: What does the doctor-guided regenerative program include?
faqs.answer: Your program includes a full medical consultation with a board-certified doctor, your customized in-office PRP or exosome treatment, topical numbing for comfort, and follow-up progress check-ins.

faqs.question: Are PRP and exosome injections painful?
faqs.answer: Not at all! We use strong topical numbing creams before every procedure. Most patients report minimal pressure and return to work or normal activities the same day.

faqs.question: How many sessions do I need to see results?
faqs.answer: Joint and hair restoration protocols typically show great results over 2 to 3 sessions. Intimacy treatments (P-Shot) often deliver noticeable improvements after just one treatment!

faqs.question: How do exosomes differ from stem cell treatments?
faqs.answer: Exosomes are non-cellular natural messengers that carry healing instructions to your cells. They do not replicate or engraft, making them an extremely safe, pure cellular signal for fast healing.
